name: OpenMAIC
description: Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom — Get an immersive, multi-agent learning experience in just one click
one_liner: An AI that builds a full interactive online course for you from a topic, document, or video — just describe what you want taught.
buyer: A corporate L&D manager who needs new employee-onboarding training built fast without hiring an instructional designer.
business_use_cases: A corporate training team turns a 40-page compliance PDF into an interactive course with quizzes in an afternoon instead of a two-week contract with an instructional designer.
An independent coach converts their webinar recordings into a structured, sellable multi-lesson course.
A test-prep tutor generates a custom practice course for a student's specific weak topics from their textbook chapters.

money_ideas.idea: Run a "course-in-a-day" production service for small coaching businesses and trainers who want a polished course but don't know how to build one.
White-label the tool as a course-authoring add-on for corporate LMS platforms.

steal_this: Take a client's existing PDF or slide deck this weekend and turn it into a finished interactive mini-course, then sell it back to them as a $500 done-for-you package.
